name: historical recall
description: An invented project whose event store changes. The replacement never names the old store, so a question about the past can only be answered from what memory kept of it. A later correction moves the date of the change, which separates what was true on a day from what was known on that day. Unrelated notes in between give the dreams something else to consolidate, and a last dream with no new evidence checks that nothing drifts.
